DNPC.Niveau.patrols: Patrols: real time, perception and catch phrases, no engagement
DNPC.Niveau.engage: Engagement: + alerts and combat start; in combat, piloted tokens hand over to the GM
DNPC.Niveau.combat: Combat: + combat AI with the basic actions
DNPC.Niveau.full: Full: + abilities declared by the engine's content
DNPC.Reglage.Niveau.Indic: What the AI is allowed to do. On top of it, each token has its own autopilot (on, confirm, off).
DNPC.Reglage.Omniscient.Indic: Creatures read the PCs' exact hit points instead of their appearance (fresh, hurt, bloodied, near death).
DNPC.Moteur.Absent: DAS · Automated NPC: the dnd5e-combat engine is not active, the module stays idle.
DNPC.Moteur.Niveau: DAS · Automated NPC: the engine's automation level is below “Assisted”; without opportunity attacks and reactions, the combat AI will be limited.
DNPC.Pilote.Erreur: Autopilot: {name}'s turn failed ({error}). The turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Refus.PJ: {name} is a player character: never piloted.
DNPC.Pilote.Refus.Joueur: {name} is owned by a player: never piloted.
DNPC.Pilote.Refus.Secret: {name} is a Secret token: never piloted.
DNPC.Pilote.Trace.SansReponse: no answer from the engine in time
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.noEnemy: No enemy perceived: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.noAttack: No usable attack on the sheet: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.outOfReach: No enemy within reach, even by moving: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.ordered: Its turn was decided by an order (Command): nothing to play.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.targeting: The engine is waiting for a target (a spell at the start of the turn): the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.paused: The game is paused: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.timeout: The turn took too long: the rest is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.refused: This token can no longer be piloted: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.refusedByEngine: The engine did not carry out the attack: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Reglage.PiloteDefaut.Indic: For tokens whose autopilot was never set (token HUD, brain button). Player characters and player-owned tokens are never piloted.
DNPC.Reglage.FinDeTour.Indic: After a piloted token has played (or had nothing to do), move to the next turn. Off: the GM ends it.
DNPC.Reglage.Delai.Nom: Delay before and after a piloted turn (ms)
DNPC.Reglage.Delai.Indic: Lets the engine finish its start of turn, and lets the table see what happened.
DNPC.Reglage.Temps.Nom: Time limit of a piloted turn (s)
DNPC.Reglage.Temps.Indic: Beyond it, the rest of the turn goes back to the GM.
DNPC.Reglage.IA.Indic: Master switch of the autopilot (also in the token tool bar). Off: no token is piloted, whatever its own autopilot.
DNPC.Reglage.Engagement.Indic: A GM creature that sees a hostile creature, or a creature that is attacked, starts the combat (also in the token tool bar). Only the creatures concerned join: a player character no hostile creature sees stays out, and joins as soon as one sees it. Works even with the AI off.
DNPC.Engagement.Entrent: Joining: {names}. Players roll their initiative; the combat begins once everyone has one.
DNPC.Engagement.Repere: {name} has been spotted: roll your initiative!
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.noPath: No path to the target: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.noMovement: No movement left this turn to close in: the turn is yours.
DNPC.Pilote.Rend.engineTooOld: The engine (DAS · Core) is too old to approach a target: the turn is yours.
